method: Rendered locked PDF pages at 180 dpi and compared source forms, translations, line continuations, inline italic terms, and interlinear alignment with extracted-records.json.

samples.result: source note preserved separately from Thao form
slash-delimited alternatives and their shared material match print
all five records are visibly present and match the reviewed extraction
printed opening quote plus A matches the aligned FUT or A gloss

notes: The source en dash marks morpheme boundaries; an ASCII hyphen at a line ending is print hyphenation and is removed during reassembly.
Italic Thao terms embedded in English translations remain part of the translation and do not start new records.
Separately indented notes and dictionary definitions are excluded from the corpus scope.
The parenthetical placement notes in dictionary examples blust-dict-p0431-e003 and blust-dict-p0460-e009 are retained as source_note and excluded from the Thao FORM.
Custom vertical-bar and backslash glyph codes are decoded as the printed em dash and opening double quotation mark.
Twenty-seven printed source-word positions have no independently aligned gloss; they remain null rather than receiving inferred glosses.
Three text 5 positions where Type3 extraction dropped a printed A after an opening quote are restored from the rendered page and aligned gloss.
The generic pdfplumber audit matched 8,614 of 8,802 generated sentences but found zero numbered example regions; five rendered samples from its unmatched bucket all matched the source.
